summary: Intercont (Cayman) Ltd filed a 6-K reporting board resolutions to hold a Class A meeting and an EGM on June 5, 2026, seeking approval to increase authorized share capital to US$250M (100B shares), redesignate shares, change Class B voting rights from 30 to 100 votes per share, adopt amended articles, and effect a reverse share split of Class A shares. No price, premium, or value is stated. This is a routine corporate governance filing to amend capital structure and voting rights, not a special situation.
